release: combined v2 (one rule set for both markets)
classification_integrity: Both markets are classified by one versioned, rule-based evaluator. The dashboard shows the classes in use (display only: the preliminary tier is named 'Strong' on screen, and the two classes with no funds are shown only if a fund falls into them; no class is merged and the saved results are unchanged) and warns if the markets are ever on different rule versions. No category distribution is targeted: the counts are whatever the fixed rules produce.
ui_runtime_note: Install requirements.txt before launching Streamlit: pip install -r requirements.txt, then streamlit run app.py
